<module id="float_multi">
	<description>A module implementing IEEE 754 compliant floating point multiply.</description>
	<ports>
		<input id="clk">Clock signal.</input>
		<input id="rst">Active-high reset signal.</input>
		<input id="a" width_description="[31:0]">First operand in IEEE 754 format.</input>
		<input id="b" width_description="[31:0]">Second operand in IEEE 754 format.</input>
		<output id="z" width_description="[31:0]">Result in IEEE 754 format.</output>
	endports
	<parameter_description>
		SHIFT_RIGHT = 3'd0;
		MULTIPLY_MANTISSA = 3'd1;
		NORMALIZE = 3'd2;
		ADD_EXPONENTS = 3'd3;
		ROUND = 3'd4;
		OUTPUT = 3'd5;
	endparameter_description
	
	<logic_description type="sequential_logic">
		reg [2:0] counter;
		reg [23:0] a_mantissa, b_mantissa, z_mantissa;
		reg [9:0] a_exponent, b_exponent, z_exponent;
		reg a_sign, b_sign, z_sign;
		reg [49:0] product;
		reg guard_bit, round_bit, sticky;
		
		initial begin
			counter = 0;
		end
		
		always @(posedge clk) begin
			case(counter)
				SHIFT_RIGHT: begin
					if(a_exponent == 0) begin
						a_mantissa <= {1'b0, a[22 : 0]};
					end else begin
						a_mantissa <= {1'b1, a[22 : 0]};
					end
					
					if(b_exponent == 0) begin
						b_mantissa <= {1'b0, b[22 : 0]};
					end else begin
						b_mantissa <= {1'b1, b[22 : 0]};
					end
					
					z_sign <= a_sign ^ b_sign;
					counter <= MULTIPLY_MANTISSA;
				end
				
				MULTIPLY_MANTISSA: begin
					product <= a_mantissa * b_mantissa;
					counter <= NORMALIZE;
				end
				
				NORMALIZE: begin
					if(product[47]) begin
						product <= product >> 1;
						z_exponent <= a_exponent + b_exponent - 1023 + 1;
					end else begin
						z_exponent <= a_exponent + b_exponent - 1023;
					end
					
					counter <= ADD_EXPONENTS;
				end
				
				ADD_EXPONENTS: begin
					guard_bit <= product[22];
					round_bit <= |product[21:0]; // OR reduction operator
					sticky <= |product[49:23];
					
					counter <= ROUND;
				end
				
				ROUND: begin
					if(z_exponent >= 2047) begin
						z_mantissa <= 0;
						z_exponent <= 2047;
					end else if(z_exponent <= 0) begin
						z_mantissa <= 0;
						z_exponent <= 0;
					end else begin
						if(guard_bit && (round_bit || sticky || z_mantissa[0])) begin
							z_mantissa <= product[46:23] + 1;
							
							if(z_mantissa[23]) begin
								z_exponent <= z_exponent + 1;
							end
						end else begin
							z_mantissa <= product[46:23];
						end
					end
					
					counter <= OUTPUT;
				end
				
				OUTPUT: begin
					if($signed(z_exponent) == -127 && $signed(z_mantissa) == 0) begin
						z <= {z_sign, 31'b0};
					end else if($signed(z_exponent) > 127 && $signed(z_mantissa) == 0) begin
						z <= {z_sign, 8'hFF, 23'b0}; // Infinity
					end else begin
						z <= {z_sign, z_exponent[7:0], z_mantissa[22:0]};
					end
					
					counter <= SHIFT_RIGHT;
				end
			endcase
			
			if(rst) begin
				counter</logic_description></parameter_description></ports></module>
